timestamps_utc.derivation: DERIVED FROM FILE TIMESTAMPS, not logged by the script: start = birth time of the launcher's stdout capture file (tasks/bl41zwhpk.output); end = mtime of the report.json the census wrote. The census does not emit its own clock; treat these as +/- a few seconds.

frozen_parameters.kill_rule: BEAR n_eff_adj < 30 at h=13 => route dead
frozen_parameters.bar_grid: 39 canonical RTH 10-min slots (09:30..15:50 ET); slot = (minutes since 09:30)//10; missing = NaN; position is never treated as time
frozen_parameters.bar_times_used: t = 13..25 (0-indexed); t = 26..38 dropped (close-truncated labels) -- the drop IS the >= h gap
frozen_parameters.block: mean of the 13 bar-time ICs of one session; one block per session by construction
frozen_parameters.ic_estimator: cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation per bar-time

drift.order: layer 1 (name-days excluded from all downstream use), then layer 2 (name excluded entirely)

eligibility.evaluated_on: coverage matrix BEFORE drift exclusions; re-evaluated each session; no forward knowledge

frozen_parameters.rho1_fail_closed: FAIL_CLOSED(<8 pairs) -> n_eff_adj unestablished (does not satisfy the bar)
frozen_parameters.ess_formula: n_eff_adj = n_blocks * (1 - rho1_used) / (1 + rho1_used), rho1_used = max(rho1_raw, 0)

input_manifest.aggregate_method: sha256 of the UTF-8 text formed by joining, with '\n' and no trailing newline, the lines '<ticker> <sha256>' for tickers in sorted() order
